title: Pháp Chánh Truyền
attributionNote: A foundational institutional text of the Tay Ninh Holy See. The English version published online by the Sacerdotal Council is explicitly marked as not an official translation.
description: The Pháp Chánh Truyền sets out the religious constitution and hierarchy of the Tay Ninh Cao Dai body. It is one branch’s institutional text, not a document accepted identically by all Cao Dai communities.
historicalContext: Cao Dai was founded in 1926 in southern Vietnam and combines Buddhist, Confucian, Daoist, Christian and local elements. The movement has divided into branches with different authorities.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. The English translation is not official and rights are unclear. No text is imported.
